brief: Reduce the permissible load for asset SUB-SGW-451 in accordance with the ambient de-rating and sustained event provisions in MG-021, since the overnight minimum of 17.76 degrees does not trigger the 24-degree threshold for additional sustained reductions in MG-021 or MG-025. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period as specified in MG-021, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified. As outlined in MG-023, prioritize this 22-year-old unit for attention ahead of younger units due to its cumulative thermal exposure and age.
